caption: The drawing consists of three views of a single shoe placed on a beige background. The largest image is of a high-heeled shoe seen from the side, predominantly colored light tan with outlines and details rendered in black and gray. The shoe features a pointed toe, a gently curving vamp with a V-shaped notch, and a short, inward-curved heel. The top edge of the shoe is accented with a slightly darker trim. Above and to the left are two smaller sketches, done in simple black line without color; one shows the shoe from a top-down view displaying the pointed toe and the V-shaped vamp, while the other appears to be a bottom or insole view, elongated and narrow, suggesting the shoe’s form. The entire composition is centered on the page with significant empty space around the images.
title: Wedding Slippers
